Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly swapped the birth years of the two directors. The WebSurfer had correctly identified Oscar Barney Finn as born on October 28, 1938, and Jason Michael Brescia as born on June 19, 1986. However, the Planner's conclusion stated that Brescia was born in 1943 and Finn in 1986, reversing the actual dates found in the previous search results. This data entry error led to the logically opposite conclusion (claiming Brescia was born earlier when he was actually born later).
